programme.title: Christmas Catch
programme.desc: Detective Bennett is on the trail of a thief and goes undercover to find where he’s hiding the loot. While undercover, she falls for the supposed thief and begins to suspect that he’s been framed. Was he framed? Or are feelings clouding her judgment?

programme.title: All We Need For Christmas
programme.desc: For the Sullivan family, the Christmas season is anything but jolly as they prepare for their first holiday following the loss of their wife and mother. But everything changes one winter night when an unexpected visitor arrives at the Sullivan's door seeking shelter and offering a much-needed gift: hope

programme.title: A Christmas of Wonders
programme.desc: Eliza, a writer for travel magazines and websites, has returned to her small hometown after an absence. Despite the passage of time, not much has changed in the town, and her family continues to participate in the same traditions. Through these activities, Eliza is reunited with Will, a former heartthrob, who helps her rediscover the significance of these family traditions.

programme.title: Christmas Recipe For Romance
programme.desc: The owner of a historic inn decides to enter a prestigious cooking contest to win funds for renovations and get free publicity, but she is a horrible cook. She recruits a renowned chef to help but the kitchen isn't the only thing heating up.

programme.title: Christmas with a View
programme.desc: Secret aspirations between a failed restaurateur and a celebrity chef threaten their blossoming Christmas romance.

programme.title: Christmas Harmony
programme.desc: A successful songwriter returns to her small hometown to rediscover music, family bonds and the magic of the Christmas season.

programme.title: Christmas In Paris
programme.desc: Lucas, a wealthy French entrepreneur, heads to Montana for a very attractive business proposal. When there he meets Robin, falls in love, and whisks her away to Paris on a whirlwind Christmas Adventure. But will business bring an end to this romance?

programme.title: Christmas Coupon
programme.desc: Alison Grant begins teaching ice skating students on a friend's frozen pond after being fired from her rink job. programme.desc: Caught in a blizzard five days before Christmas, pregnant 23-year-old Lisa, and her new friend Brad, a professional snowboarder, take shelter at The Rosemont. A once great winter resort, The Rosemont has seen better days. After losing her daughter and granddaughter, the cantankerous owner Josephine has let it fall into disrepair.
